hibernate-mapping.query: from DienstContract as f where f.contractNummer = :ContractNummer
select f from DienstContract as f where f.klantId = :KlantId order by f.contractPeriodeVan asc, f.contractNummer asc
select f from DienstContract as f where id in (:ids)
select count(klantId) from DienstContract as c where c.klantId = :Id
select count(voertuigId) from DienstContract as c where c.voertuigId = :Id
